cardFixesApplied.to: Zotye T600 je středně velké SUV z roku 2013 a nejprodávanější model značky, vzhledem připomínající Audi Q5 a VW Touareg. Vznikly varianty Sport a Coupe; po modernizaci v roce 2018 zůstala jen verze Coupe pod názvem T600. Výroba skončila s útlumem automobilky (bankrot 2021, obnovení 2022, zastavení výroby v červnu 2025).

openQuestions: types.ts has no 'cvt' gearbox type, but src/lib/modelCards.ts renders 'cvt' and toyota/ford cards still use it. Zotye CVTs became 'automatic' with gears null. Should 'cvt' be added to types.ts and this change reverted?
Zotye is China-only; the only European link is the LUIS 4U (an electric 5008 sold in Germany). The cards stay as they are, at low priority.
summary: Zotye cards largely match Wikipedia. Fixes: 16 trims of invalid kind 'version' and 7 CVT entries made type-conformant; T600, V10 and E30 marked ended (the company halted production in 2025); M300 2009 and T500 2018 start years; Z700H facelift; E200 kerb weight. Proposed: drop the Hawtai E70 (wrong make) and the QID alias, and add the 22 card lines to model-lines-auto.
